== anonymous, virtual-host: objects
GET https://bkt.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/
  query encoding-type=url
  query list-type=2
  header Amz-Sdk-Invocation-Id: <uuid>
  header Amz-Sdk-Request: attempt=1; max=1
  header User-Agent: <swath> aws-sdk-go-v2/<version> ua/2.1 os/<platform> lang/go#<version> md/GOOS#<platform> md/GOARCH#<platform> api/s3#<version>
  header X-Amz-Content-Sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
  body 0 bytes
== anonymous, virtual-host: objects, every option

  query delimiter=%2F
  query encoding-type=url

  query list-type=2

  query prefix=p%2Fa+b%2Bc%25%2F%C3%A9%26%3D%3F

  body 0 bytes
